tests.title: Login page renders with form

Step 3: Verify login form elements are present

tests.title: Login with valid player credentials
tests.description: Verify successful login redirects to the player dashboard
tests.expected_result: User is redirected to the player dashboard
tests.pass_criteria: URL contains '/app/player' and element with data-testid='page-player-dashboard' is visible
tests.failure_reason: Browser session became unresponsive after login form submission — screenshots and URL checks failed repeatedly
tests.blocked_reason: Browser automation session crashes after Supabase auth redirect. Login was submitted but browser could not capture post-redirect state. Not an app bug — browser tool limitation.
